fact: An AI-assisted VIA app for cervical cancer screening was tested at Kicukiro Health Center, Kigali, from 18 June to 25 July 2025 on 251 women, showing sensitivity 33.3% and specificity 92.2% against expert consensus.
title: Screening Performance and Implementation Determinants of an AI-Assisted Visual Inspection application for Cervical Cancer Screening in Rwanda
